settings.heading: App settings
settings.introduction: Shared across all workspaces. Your workspace stays where it is. Opening this dialog performs no native operation.
settings.backupsHelp: Back up now writes one versioned ZIP named app.config.<Unix seconds> containing settings.json, every saved open and closed Tab and package .config file and recognized legacy profiles, exactly as stored. Package payloads, logs and earlier backups are excluded; the archive is not encrypted.
settings.backupDirectoryHelp: Saved with the other App settings by Save changes. Blank means the default backups directory under the selected root. The host creates a private directory when missing and refuses unsafe or linked ones.
settings.backupNowHelp: Uses the saved destination now, independent of Save. Stop stays available while the archive is written.
settings.backupUnsaved: The backup directory edit above is unsaved: this snapshot uses the saved destination and does not save the edit.
settings.backupPending: Writing snapshot… its result is kept even if this dialog closes.
settings.backupFailed: Snapshot did not complete · check the diagnostic before retrying
settings.saveFailed: Previous stored settings are unchanged. Correct the draft and save again.
settings.unsaved: Unsaved changes · Cancel or Escape discards them
settings.languageHelp: Language changes only after Save succeeds. Selecting a language does not preview it. Cancel keeps the saved language.
settings.notificationsHelp: Short-lived cards at the bottom right. Blocking failures and cleanup outcomes remain on the Run page regardless of cards.
settings.visibleHelp: Older cards leave the stack immediately; every event stays in the relevant log.
settings.timeoutHelp: The timer pauses while you hover or focus a card. Cards already shown keep the duration they were created with.
settings.successHelp: Warnings and errors are never suppressed by this switch.
settings.logsHelp: One bounded buffer shared by every workspace and application log page. File logs and delivery queues are unaffected.
settings.saveError: Settings were not saved · draft kept

invalid.one: Correct {count} invalid field before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.other: Correct {count} invalid fields before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.oneCategories: Correct {count} invalid field in {categories} before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits
invalid.otherCategories: Correct {count} invalid fields in {categories} before saving · Cancel or Escape discards all edits

settings.wait: Save waits until “{reason}” settles · Cancel or Escape discards unsaved edits
settings.logLimitHelp: 1–10000 · default 1000 · saved limit {limit}. Lowering it trims the shared history immediately after Save.

environment.noDescriptor: None selected · initialization could not be checked
environment.setDescriptor: None · set the recorded corpus descriptor on the workspace Run page
environment.authority: A check never admits a run. Start captures and revalidates every file again, including same-path replacements; no path is watched.
environment.saveFirst: Save an OCR environment to enable Check.
environment.dirty: Check reads saved settings only. Save changes first.
environment.active: Another operation owns the runner until its terminal outcome is recorded.
environment.introduction: Machine-local, saved in App settings, never in portable profiles. Save validates structure only; Check initializes the engine.
environment.modelPlaceholder: Absolute path to the accepted model files
environment.runtimePlaceholder: Absolute path to the pinned ONNX runtime library
environment.libraries: Reviewed native library paths · one per line
environment.librariesPlaceholder: Explicit non-system libraries the engine child may load
environment.librariesHelp: Enter 1–64 absolute paths; blank lines are ignored. Rust canonicalizes them and derives file and SDK identities during Check and again on every Start. Listing a path is not an audit of every loaded image.
environment.blank: Saving a blank draft stores no OCR environment.
environment.saveHelp: Save changes below writes this environment with the other App settings.
environment.checkHelp: Validates files, then initializes the engine against the selected corpus without evaluating package code. Stop applies.
environment.noCorpus: Without a descriptor, Check validates files and reports the missing corpus; it cannot claim initialization.
environment.noChecks: No check has completed in this session.

truncated.one: Display truncated: {count} more character is not rendered.
truncated.other: Display truncated: {count} more characters are not rendered.

environment.staleHelp: This result belongs to its original selection only: {reasons}. It does not make the current environment appear checked.
environment.wait: {reason} · Check waits until this command settles.

profileLabels.g-004-rapidocr-ppocrv4-det-v6-rec-small-: G-004 · RapidOCR PP-OCRv4 det v6 / rec small v1

environment.mismatch: The saved environment carries a tuple this desktop build does not offer ({model} / {language} / {provider} / {runtime}). Saving replaces it with the supported tuple shown above.

run.introduction: Edits affect the next operation, never the active snapshot. Every Start revalidates files; no check or inspection is reused.
run.diagnosticHelp: Full diagnostics are available through explicit private disclosure in the Execution panel.
run.noOperations: No operation for this workspace yet
run.replaySummary: Recorded corpus, real recognition, controlled sink
run.controlledSummary: Fixture observations, no live capture or input
run.confirmReinspect: Discard the unsaved draft and reinspect this package?
run.reinspectBlocked: Inspection is refused while this workspace owns an operation
run.reinspectHelp: Reinspection validates inventory, schema, and static dependencies without executing package code; it increments the selection revision and resets the draft.
run.profilesError: Some saved profiles could not be loaded
run.profilesHelp: Compatible profiles and new drafts remain available. Stored files were not modified. Restore compatible data, then reinspect.
run.legacyHelp: Copies compatible pre-change profiles/*.json from the selected root into this workspace's package store, preserving IDs and values. Conflicting IDs are refused without overwrite, source files are kept, and identical committed entries are skipped on retry. Nothing is shared with other workspaces.
run.staleSchema: Stale schema identity. This profile cannot be rebound or run.
run.presetHelp: Choosing a preset creates a new draft. Save it with a name to keep it.
run.optionsHelp: Missing top-level fields use schema defaults. Explicit objects are never recursively filled. Backend validation reports exact field paths.
run.replay: Replay · recorded corpus, real recognition, controlled sink
run.native: Native · refused, no live capture or input
run.descriptorPlaceholder: Absolute path to a replay descriptor JSON
run.authority: Submitted does not prove effect; Stop does not prove cleanup. Stop covers checks and runs alike.
run.capturedOptions: Captured options · unchanged by draft edits
run.capturedEnvironment: Captured saved environment · unchanged by later edits
run.heading: {label} / Run control
run.descriptorHelp: A location hint for this workspace session only, bounded to {limit} bytes. Replay Start and OCR Check read the descriptor and its declared assets through this package's inventory each time; unknown or native fields are refused.

startUses.draft: Start uses the explicit draft shown here.
startUses.replayProfile: Start uses saved profile “{profile}”, the saved OCR environment ({environment}), and descriptor {descriptor}.
startUses.replayDraft: Start uses the explicit draft shown here, the saved OCR environment ({environment}), and descriptor {descriptor}.

run.olderRevision: This outcome belongs to selection revision {old}; the workspace is now at revision {current}. It is not evidence for the current draft.
run.stopTarget: Stop targets operation {operation} regardless of the visible workspace.

result.checkHelp: No package module, readiness, or workflow code was evaluated. Engine facts are the child's own report.
result.privateHelp: Script decisions and observation records stay hidden until disclosed below. Full records are not automatically copied to ordinary logs; scripts can explicitly emit bounded messages.

truncated.one: Display truncated: {count} more character is retained by the backend record but not rendered.
truncated.other: Display truncated: {count} more characters are retained by the backend record but not rendered.

disclosureHelp.ordinary: Build metadata, diagnostics. Rendered here only, bounded to {kib} KiB.
disclosureHelp.private: Build metadata, diagnostics, and recognition detail. Rendered here only, bounded to {kib} KiB.

schema.omitted: Omitted · no nested defaults are applied.

logs.missingHelp: It was evicted from the bounded display buffer or never delivered to the GUI queue. Retained operation outcomes stay on the Run page; file logs are unaffected.
logs.search: Search code, message, source, or run
logs.searchPlaceholder: Search code, message, source, or run ID
logs.empty: No retained events for this scope. Events may still have been evicted from the display buffer or written only to file logs.
logs.order: Newest first · search matches code, message, source, and run only

filtered.one: No retained events match the current filters. {count} event in this scope is hidden by filtering.
filtered.other: No retained events match the current filters. {count} events in this scope are hidden by filtering.

lossHelp.loss: Loss counters are cumulative and independent of this page. Display eviction does not delete file records or change retained results. A filtered or empty page is not a claim that no events occurred.
lossHelp.none: No display eviction, transport loss, or file-output failure has been recorded. Display eviction does not delete file records or change retained results. A filtered or empty page is not a claim that no events occurred.

bootstrap.presentationHelp: Temporary. Applies only until saved settings load; it is not written anywhere and is not read from the failed file.
bootstrap.setupIntro: No App settings exist at the selected location. Initialize writes only settings.json with the choices below. It inspects no package, needs no OCR or target and starts nothing.
bootstrap.recoveryIntro: The configuration at the selected location could not be used. The original data was preserved: nothing was replaced, repaired or reset automatically.
bootstrap.laterFault: Configuration became unusable after start. The existing Application, polling and Stop stay available; Retry and Restore wait until operations and commands settle.
bootstrap.applicationUnavailable: Normal workspace commands are unavailable until the application is ready.
bootstrap.causeHelp: This cause stays until an authoritative Retry, Initialize or Restore resolves it. Editing forms or dismissing notices does not clear it.
bootstrap.repairHelp: Repair the file or permissions externally, or start with --data-dir PATH. The desktop performs no chmod, elevation or hidden fallback.
bootstrap.disclosure: Paths on this screen are disclosed deliberately; they are not written to ordinary logs or notifications.
bootstrap.savedLanguageHelp: Written to settings.json by Initialize. Separate from the temporary display language above.
bootstrap.backupDirectoryHelp: Absolute private directory for configuration snapshots. Blank keeps the default backups directory under the root.
bootstrap.initializeHelp: Creates settings.json only if it is still missing and validates it before publication. Existing directories and data are never cleared.
bootstrap.legacyHelp: A previous default root exists at {path}. Import copies its recognized App settings and legacy profile files into a private staging root and publishes only a complete result without replacing anything. Logs, backups and unrecognized files stay in the source; the source is never deleted.
bootstrap.startFresh: Start fresh without importing the historical root
bootstrap.startFreshHelp: Initialize stays unavailable until you import or confirm a fresh start.
bootstrap.retryHelp: Rereads the actual source. After external repair, Retry succeeds without restarting the application and starts one polling owner.
bootstrap.pendingRestoreHelp: A restore journal is pending. Ordinary configuration use is blocked until it is completed or rolled back. Evidence is not deleted and no mixed configuration is loaded.
bootstrap.recoverConfirm: I understand this changes the managed configuration set
bootstrap.snapshotHelp: Back up now writes one versioned ZIP named app.config.<Unix seconds> with settings.json, every saved Tab and package .config file and recognized legacy profiles, exactly as stored, even when they cannot be decoded. Package payloads, logs and earlier backups are excluded; the archive is not encrypted.
bootstrap.destinationHelp: Blank uses the saved or default destination. This field is never saved and does not repair App settings.
bootstrap.snapshotFailed: Snapshot did not complete · check the diagnostic before retrying
bootstrap.restoreHelp: The archive is validated before any live file changes. Restore then replaces the managed configuration set: App settings and saved open and closed Tab and package settings. Unsaved drafts, runs, package payloads and logs are not merged. Present configuration requires a matching snapshot clicked in this session.
bootstrap.preimageNone: No current preservation receipt · take a snapshot before replacing existing configuration
bootstrap.restoreConfirm: Replace saved App, Tab and package configuration with this snapshot
bootstrap.discardConfirm: Rebuild the application session and discard unsaved drafts and transient results

block.active: Wait for the active operation to settle.
block.command: Wait for the pending command to settle.
block.discard: Confirm session reconstruction and discarding unsaved drafts.

bootstrap.actionFailedHelp: The bootstrap state below is authoritative and unchanged by this refusal.
bootstrap.catalogFaults: Saved workspace files that could not be loaded
bootstrap.catalogFaultsHelp: Their bytes were preserved and healthy workspaces stay usable. Repair or restore them; nothing is adopted or deleted.

create.heading: New workspace
create.intro: Choose an internal name and an optional display name. No package, path, OCR or target is required; the workspace is saved as soon as it is created.
create.internalHelp: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits 0–9, _ or -; no spaces. Unique across saved workspaces (case-insensitive), kept exactly as typed and immutable. Names the folder tabs/<name>.
create.displayHelp: Leave empty to use the internal name. Otherwise, enter 1–80 nonblank characters, kept exactly as typed. Duplicates are allowed and shown with the internal name.
create.failedHelp: Nothing was written and no other workspace changed. Correct the names and try again.
create.openLimit: {limit} workspaces are open. Close one before creating another; closed workspaces stay saved.
create.savedLimit: {limit} workspaces are saved. Creation is refused without evicting any of them.

errors.internalLong: Internal names are at most 64 characters.
errors.internalChars: Use only ASCII letters, digits 0–9, _ and -; spaces are refused.
errors.displayBlank: Leave the display name empty or enter a name containing more than whitespace.
errors.displayLong: Display names are at most 80 characters.
errors.displayControl: Display names cannot contain control characters.

reopen.heading: Saved workspaces
reopen.intro: Closed workspaces keep their names and package settings. Reopen issues a fresh session; drafts, results and runs are not restored.
reopen.failedHelp: It stays closed and saved; nothing else changed.
reopen.limit: {limit} workspaces are open; close one to reopen another.

guidance.heading: No package yet
guidance.intro: This workspace is saved with its names only. Package authoring (Edit), custom package archives and remote download are not delivered in this desktop build; there is no placeholder editor, sample package or fake form here.
guidance.where: Package authoring will belong to a later Edit surface that produces an ordinary package directory or a custom packaged artifact for this workspace. Until then, author packages outside the desktop and inspect their directory below.
guidance.inspectHelp: Inspection loads the schema and this workspace's saved profiles without executing package code. It binds the directory to this workspace only; other workspaces referencing the same directory keep independent settings.
guidance.packagePlaceholder: Absolute path to a package directory
guidance.inspectRecovery: No package was bound. Correct the directory or package, then Inspect again; the workspace and its saved settings are unchanged.
guidance.unsupportedHeading: Saved package is a custom archive
guidance.unsupportedHelp: This workspace references a custom packaged artifact. The current directory inspector cannot load, unpack or run it; this is not a claim that no package exists. The reference is kept. Inspect a package directory to bind a directory source instead.
guidance.unavailableHeading: Saved package could not be inspected
guidance.unavailableHelp: The saved directory reference is kept and package-dependent commands are refused. Nothing was replaced with defaults. Repair the package or inspect another directory.
guidance.stopHelp: An operation owned by another workspace keeps its Stop in the strip above; nothing on this page starts, stops or retargets it.
